name: threejs-skills
readme: Skill files that give Claude Code current, verified knowledge of three.js, so the code it writes runs on the release you actually install. The skills target three.js r186 (three@0.186), React Three Fiber 9.8 with drei 10.7, and gltf-transform 4.5. Rendering examples use WebGLRenderer, directly or through React Three Fiber; the WebGPU and TSL section in every skill covers WebGPURenderer.
